content.scenario: The State Commission of Maharashtra wants to exercise administrative control over all the District Commissions within its jurisdiction.
content.outcome: The State Commission of Maharashtra has the authority to exercise administrative control over all the District Commissions within its jurisdiction, as per the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What is the scope of administrative control of the State Commission?
Can the State Commission exercise control over District Commissions outside its jurisdiction?
What are the powers of the State Commission in relation to District Commissions?
